```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
```

## Load Data from ZIP

```{r load-data}
zip_path <- "../../data/covid_processed_v10_march14.zip"

zip_contents <- utils::unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)
csv_name <- zip_contents$Name[grepl("\\.csv$", zip_contents$Name)][1]

if (is.na(csv_name)) {
  stop("No CSV file found inside the ZIP archive.")
}

extract_dir <- tempdir()
utils::unzip(zip_path, files = csv_name, exdir = extract_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
csv_path <- file.path(extract_dir, csv_name)

df <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Build One Row per Country

The source is a time series, so these country-level covariates appear repeatedly. To ensure each country contributes once to group means, we collapse to one row per country.

```{r country-level}
vars <- c(
  "gdp_per_capita",
  "human_development_index",
  "extreme_poverty",
  "hospital_beds_per_thousand"
)

one_value_per_country <- function(x) {
  vals <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(vals) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  mean(vals)
}

country_level <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(continent), continent != "", !is.na(country), country != "") %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(vars), one_value_per_country),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Compute Mean Table

```{r summary-table}
safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

compute_group_means <- function(country_df, group_name, countries = NULL) {
  selected <- if (is.null(countries)) {
    country_df
  } else {
    country_df %>% filter(country %in% countries)
  }

  tibble(
    Group = group_name,
    Countries_included = dplyr::n_distinct(selected$country),
    gdp_per_capita = safe_mean(selected$gdp_per_capita),
    human_development_index = safe_mean(selected$human_development_index),
    extreme_poverty = safe_mean(selected$extreme_poverty),
    hospital_beds_per_thousand = safe_mean(selected$hospital_beds_per_thousand)
  )
}

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  compute_group_means(country_level, "1) Global (all countries in dataset)"),
  compute_group_means(country_level, "2) First country list", countries_list_1),
  compute_group_means(country_level, "3) Second country list", countries_list_2)
)

summary_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  rename(
    `GDP per capita` = gdp_per_capita,
    `Human development index` = human_development_index,
    `Extreme poverty` = extreme_poverty,
    `Hospital beds per thousand` = hospital_beds_per_thousand
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrr")
```
